observations: body L1-L2: the end of Boll's note on the cardinal points of the Babylonians, begun on p. XIX; each line of the quotation opens with a guillemet. The κ of «κατὰ» is the open form of this type (ϰ).
body L3-L19: the addendum on the book of Hermes (to p. lxxix and 309, n. 2). «Hermetis» (L3, L15), «Griffini» (L4, L19) and «Pseudo-Procli» are letter-spaced; «lxxix» is in small capitals.

body L4-L15: the incipit (L4-L8), the explicit (L8-L12) and the colophon (L12-L15) of the codex, set right to left inside the Latin lines as printed: «هذا كتاب هرمس» ends L4, L5-L14 hold Arabic only except the parentheses «(cod. sine punctis)» (L5), «(اصع cod.)» (L9), «(السنن cod.)» (L10), whose Latin abbreviation stands at the left of its Arabic word as printed, and «— Ita explicit:» at the left end of L8, after the stop that closes the incipit; L15 begins with «الهجرة النبوية (4)» followed by the Latin. L5-L7 and L9-L14 fill the measure in the print; the edition sets them from the indent.

body L5, L6: «المفضَّل» has the shadda with the fatḥa over the ḍād; «يسمَّى» has the shadda with the fatḥa over the mīm; «يُعلم» has the ḍamma over the yā’. The Arabic commas (L6, L11) are printed as turned commas.

body L5, L8-L10, L14, L18: «الا» at the head of «الاوتاد» and «الاربعة» (L8), «الابواب» (L10), «الاول» (L14 and L18) is printed as one sort: the strokes of the lām-alif cross like an X under a forked top, and no separate alif of the article stands before it; the lām-alif of «ثلاثة» (L5), «كلامي», «الكلام» (L9) and «انقلاب» (L10) has the ordinary form.
body L6, L9, L10, L12: «والغي» (L9) is printed with a ghayn, in its medial form with the dot above, joined to the following yā’, where «الذي» (L6, L10, L12) has the dhāl.
body L5, L10-L14: the elongated joins of «علمــهم» (L5), «جميــع», «قــولي» (L10), «سنــة», «ومائــة» (L13), «نهــار», «ربيــع» (L14) are transcribed with tatweels.
body L14: the year «٧١» is printed in Arabic-Indic numerals.
body L18: «[و]هو»: the wāw between square brackets is Nallino's addition.
body L20-L32: the corrections to the text of the first volume: the page numbers at the margin are bold («3», «27», «43», «64», «67», «92-93», «115», «125»), the line numbers after them roman.
body L22-L23, L25: «amplius quam» (L22), «tantodem minus» (L23) and «sinus» (L25, twice) are italic.
body L26: «(= t. III, p. 95, lin. 16 يكون بقدر تعديله الاوسط)»: the Arabic words of the codex stand inside the parenthesis, right to left, as printed; the lām-alif of «الاوسط» is printed crossed.
body L32: the rough breathing of «ἡ» and of «ὁ» is joined to its letter, so that «ὁ» looks like a δ.
body: the dashes measure 9.96 pt (L17, L19); the dash before «Ita explicit» (L8) measures 7.4 pt. The hyphens measure 3.1-3.6 pt.

notes_left L1-L12, notes_right L1-L12: five notes in two columns, with a thin rule between them; note 5 runs from the left column into the right. «Proclum», «Por-» «phyrii», «Hermetis», «Th.-H.» «Martin» and «Bouché-Leclercq» are letter-spaced.
notes_left L1: the letter ṣād is printed in its initial form (ص‍).
notes_left L12: the final ς of «ἀνώνυμος» prints broken, like a semicolon.
notes_right L8: the second l of «Nonnulla» prints broken.
notes_right L11: the 9 of «449» prints broken (the left side of its loop thin, the stroke between its tail and its foot missing), so that it looks like a 2.

notes_right L11-L12: the stop after «Bouché-Leclercq» is a round dot larger than the other stops of the notes (2.0 by 2.3 pt, against 1.3 pt), with a short point below; it stands where a comma is expected before the pages «506-507» and is transcribed as a stop. The dashes of notes_right L7-L8 measure 7.3 and 8.5 pt.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
